explanation: Chile is the case every side in Portugal argued from in 1975, and that is what this edge claims. For the far left and for much of the fifth provisional government, Allende’s fall proved that a revolution which left the armed forces and the economy intact would be destroyed, and it was the argument for moving faster. For the Socialists, for the moderate officers of the Group of Nine and for the Americans, it was the outcome to be avoided at almost any cost, and Kissinger’s remark that Soares was a Kerensky is the same reading from the other end. Portuguese quarrels made the confrontation of 25 November. Chile supplied the terms in which everybody understood what they were doing. The edge is `inspired`, which is used here for an example read as a warning, and it claims nothing more.
